title: Baking Day

readiness.math: matching shapes and sizes; fitting things into a space
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: The flour you weighed is now dough, and it has risen high. Remember the story of the leaven?

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Now the loaves go into the hot oven. Each one has its own place on the baking stone.

older.prompt: Fit every loaf into the oven. Each one has a place just its shape.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Put each loaf in the place that fits its shape.
steps.hint: Watch: the long loaf goes in the long place. Can you find the next?

feedback.mismatch: That loaf doesn't fit there. Look at the shape.
feedback.all_good: Every loaf is in its place. Into the oven they go!

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Smell that! This bread started as grain at the mill. Now it is warm bread, ready to eat.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Take a loaf home for supper. Bread is better when it's shared.

journal_line: I baked bread with Mr. Tobias. I put each loaf in the oven, in the place that fit its shape.
unavailable_text: The oven is full of baking bread. It smells wonderful!
